title: NASA Announces the X-70, a New Experimental Aircraft
paragraphs: NASA has a new plane. It is called the X-70. NASA showed it on 4 November.
The X-70 is for research. It has a pilot. Scientists will test new ideas in the air. The plane can fly very high and carry things for tests.
It has not flown yet. NASA hopes it will fly in two years. The picture in the news is not a real photo.

questions.a: No, it has not flown yet.
